name: Leftover Lead Shares
query:
SELECT
	s.share_name AS "Lead:Link/CRM Lead:130",
	s.user AS "Can Open:Link/User:220",
	l.lead_owner AS "Lead Owner:Link/User:220",
	l.custom_vertical AS "Vertical:Link/CRM Vertical:110",
	l.custom_group AS "Group:Link/CRM Group:110",
	l.custom_current_program AS "Program:Link/CRM Program:130",
	s.creation AS "Shared On:Datetime:160"
FROM `tabDocShare` s FORCE INDEX (share_doctype_share_name_index)
JOIN `tabCRM Lead` l ON l.name = s.share_name
LEFT JOIN `tabToDo` t FORCE INDEX (reference_type_reference_name_index)
	ON t.reference_type = 'CRM Lead' AND t.reference_name = s.share_name AND t.allocated_to = s.user AND t.status <> 'Cancelled'
WHERE s.share_doctype = 'CRM Lead'
	AND s.user <> IFNULL(l.lead_owner, '')
	AND t.name IS NULL
ORDER BY s.creation DESC
LIMIT 1000
